values: 召唤艾洛娜对当前目标造成伤害，并在场上共同作战。
Bryon summons Elona to deal damage to the current target and fight alongside.

被动地，布莱恩拥有1000点初始能量，战斗开始时会使得猎隼艾洛娜飞至空中伺机待发。使用终极技能时，立即消耗300 − 80点能量，呼唤艾洛娜对布莱恩当前目标进行俯冲打击，造成320% ATK伤害，随后使得艾洛娜在场上协同作战，每秒消耗能量，且消耗量会随时间逐渐提升，当能量耗尽或布莱恩被击败时，艾洛娜将会离开战场。艾洛娜在战场上无法被攻击，无视地形并且优先攻击布莱恩当前的目标，普通攻击造成90% ATK伤害。

Passive. When a battle starts, Bryon gains 1000 Initial Energy and summons his falcon Elona. 
Active. Bryon consumes 300 − 80 Energy, calling Elona to deal 320% ATK damage to his current target. Elona remains on the battlefield, consuming increasing amounts of Energy over time. When she runs out of Energy or Bryon is defeated, Elona leaves the battlefield. Elona cannot be attacked and will ignore the terrain and prioritizes Bryon's target. Elona's normal attack deals 90% ATK damage.
艾洛娜持续在场上超过8秒后获得强化，普通攻击伤害提高20%，急速提高40点，强化效果会在艾洛娜离开战场后重置。
Elona gains enhanced effects after 8s into a battle. Normal attack damage is increased by 20%, and Haste is increased by 40. The enhancements are reset when Elona leaves the battlefield.
艾洛娜持续在场上超过18秒后获得再次强化，令雷电环绕自身，使得艾洛娜周围1格范围的敌人降低30点急速且每秒受到40% ATK伤害，强化效果会在艾洛娜离开战场后重置。

Elona gains enhanced thunderbolt effects after 18s into a battle, reducing Haste of adjacent enemies by 30 and dealing 40% ATK damage per second. The enhancements are reset when Elona leaves the battlefield.
艾洛娜的普通攻击伤害提升至100% ATK。
Elona's normal attack damage is increased to 100% ATK.
艾洛娜的普通攻击伤害提升至110% ATK。
Elona's normal attack damage is increased to 110% ATK.
生成魔法飞叶对敌人造成伤害。
Bryon summons magic leaves to attack the enemy.
生成4枚魔法飞叶，随后向目标快速发射全部魔法飞叶，每枚飞叶造成90% + 10% ATK伤害。
Bryon summons 4 magic leaves to attack the target. Each leaf deals 90% + 10% ATK damage.
每枚飞叶造成伤害提升至93% + 10% ATK。
The damage dealt by each leaf is increased to 93% + 10% ATK.
每枚飞叶造成伤害提升至96% + 10% ATK。
The damage dealt by each leaf is increased to 96% + 10% ATK.
每枚飞叶造成伤害提升至100% + 10% ATK。
The damage dealt by each leaf is increased to 100% + 10% ATK.
被动地，布莱恩对敌人造成若干次伤害会吸取能量；主动释放时，造成两段伤害。

Passive. Bryon deals multiple damage to enemies and absorbs their Energy. 
Active. Bryon deals damage 2 times.
被动地，布莱恩的普通攻击和技能对敌人造成2次伤害时会吸收其50点能量。主动释放时，布莱恩对敌人造成2次190% ATK伤害。

Passive. Bryon's normal attacks and skills deal damage 2 times, absorbing targets' 50 Energy. 
Active. Bryon deals 190% ATK damage 2 times.
布莱恩的普通攻击和技能对敌人造成2次伤害时，使艾洛娜的下一次普通攻击变为对敌人释放闪电打击，额外附带敌人当前生命值4% + 0.5%的伤害并造成打断效果，额外伤害最高不超过布莱恩240% + 15%的攻击力。该效果最多可以储存3次。

Bryon's normal attacks and skills deal damage 2 times, granting Elona's next normal attack with thunderbolts, dealing additional damage equal to 4% + 0.5% of enemy's current HP, along with a skill interruption effect. The extra damage cannot exceed 240% + 15% of Bryon's ATK, up to 3 stacks.
主动释放时每次造成伤害提升至195% ATK。
Active. Each damage dealt is increased to 195% ATK.
主动释放时每次造成伤害提升至200% ATK。
Active. Each damage dealt is increased to 200% ATK.
提高自身急速，艾洛娜在场上期间进一步提升急速。
Bryon's Haste increases during battle, and it further increases when Elona is on the battlefield.
战斗中，自身提高10点急速。且当艾洛娜在场上期间，额外提升3点急速。
Bryon increases his Haste by 10 during battle. He gains an extra 3 Haste when Elona is on the battlefield.
战斗中，自身提高13点急速。且当艾洛娜在场上期间，额外提升4点急速。
Bryon increases his Haste by 13 during battle. He gains an extra 4 Haste when Elona is on the battlefield.
战斗中，自身提高17点急速。且当艾洛娜在场上期间，额外提升5点急速。
Bryon increases his Haste by 17 during battle. He gains an extra 5 Haste when Elona is on the battlefield.
布莱恩受到控制效果或者单次高额伤害时，艾洛娜对敌人造成高额伤害和眩晕；艾洛娜在布莱恩受到最后一击时保护其不被击败。
When Bryon is being controlled or taking a single high-damage attack, Elona deals high damage to the enemy and stuns them. Elona can block the fatal damage for Bryon.
艾洛娜在场上时才能触发，当敌人对布莱恩施加控制效果或单次造成超过布莱恩15%最大生命值的伤害时，艾洛娜立即冲到该敌人身前，对其造成350% ATK伤害并使其眩晕，持续3秒，该效果每20秒最多生效1次。

Elona deals 350% ATK damage to the enemy and stuns them for 3s when Bryon is being controlled or receives damage exceeding 15% of his max HP from a single hit. This skill takes effect once every 20s and can only be triggered when Elona is on the field.
当布莱恩首次受到最后一击时，艾洛娜消耗所有能量立即返回布莱恩身边为其抵挡此次伤害，恢复200% ATK的生命值，并展开终极庇护，在接下来5秒内，布莱恩无法被选中，且每秒恢复40% ATK的生命值。艾洛娜随后离场并在10秒内无法被召唤。

When Bryon takes a fatal blow for the first time, Elona consumes all the Energy to block the fatal damage and restores 200% ATK HP for Bryon. For the next 5s, Bryon becomes untargetable and recovers 40% ATK HP per second. Then Elona departs from the battlefield and cannot be summoned for 10s.
艾洛娜的反击伤害提升至400% ATK。
Elona's counterattack damage is increased to 400% ATK.
艾洛娜的反击伤害提升至450% ATK。
Elona's counterattack damage is increased to 450% ATK.
释放“叶刃联击”时在艾洛娜身边额外生成飞叶。
Bryon generates two leaves beside Elona when casting Leafblade Gale.
释放“叶刃联击”时若艾洛娜在场上，还会在其身边额外生成2枚飞叶。
Bryon generates two leaves beside Elona if the falcon is on the battlefield when Leafblade Gale is cast.
艾洛娜的闪电打击会额外传导给目标2格范围内最近的其他2名敌人，且当艾洛娜的普通攻击或技能对敌人造成3次伤害时，立即使布莱恩永久提升15点急速，至多通过该效果提升120点急速。
Elona's thunderbolt attacks now jump to 2 enemies within 2 tiles. Each time Elona lands 3 hits with her normal attacks or skills, Bryon's Haste permanently increases by 15, up to a maximum of 120.
